role: external mechanism benchmark for the Palmer carrier-identifiability result; not a Palmer replication or causal identification

resighting.title: Adelie penguin resighting data 1997-2021 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science

banding.title: Adelie penguin banding data 1994-2021 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science

literature_context_known_before_data_ope: Ross Island multistate mark-recapture work reports very low movement among breeding colonies once birds have bred, while temporary nonbreeding/breeding sabbaticals can be much more common.
This literature motivates the benchmark but its published estimates are not treated as outcomes of the analysis below.
Ross Island is an external ecological system and cannot identify the latent carrier in Palmer.

required_for_known_age_filter: banding table shares stable individual identifier with resighting table
banding date/season or known age at banding
required_for_breeding_propensity_model: explicit breeding-state/status observation or a documented observation model distinguishing breeding state from nondetection
sampling/resighting effort information sufficient to estimate detection probability
fail_closed_rules: If stable individual identity cannot be linked across years, stop.
If location cannot be mapped reproducibly to a finite set of breeding sites, stop spatial-transition analysis.
Do not code a missing resighting as nonbreeding.
Do not estimate breeding propensity from encounter gaps without a detection model.

B1_conditional_location_fidelity.question: Among marked Adelie penguins resighted in two consecutive breeding seasons, how often is the next-year resighting at the same breeding-site category versus a different category?
B1_conditional_location_fidelity.unit: individual x consecutive-season transition with at least one eligible resighting in both seasons
B1_conditional_location_fidelity.multiple_resights_within_season: Use a deterministic site assignment only if the schema documents breeding/residency status or if all eligible resights for the individual-season agree on site. Discordant multi-site seasons are excluded from the primary endpoint and counted separately.
B1_conditional_location_fidelity.primary_endpoint: switch_fraction = number of consecutive-season transitions assigned to different sites / number of assignable consecutive-season transitions
B1_conditional_location_fidelity.age_filter: If known age is available, primary biological benchmark uses birds age >= 5 years; otherwise report all assignable marked birds and do not label them established breeders.
B1_conditional_location_fidelity.interpretation: A low switch fraction constrains the plausibility of mature-bird spatial switching at the spatial scale encoded by this dataset, but does not measure Palmer subcolony movement.

B2_gap_structure.role: descriptive only unless explicit breeding state and detection model pass the schema gate
B2_gap_structure.endpoint: For individuals observed in seasons t and t+2, report the fraction not resighted in t+1.
B2_gap_structure.prohibited_interpretation: Do not call a one-season encounter gap a breeding sabbatical, nonbreeding state, mortality, or emigration without a state/detection model.

B3_breeding_propensity_gate.unlock_condition: All breeding-propensity schema requirements are present and documented before fitting any model.
B3_breeding_propensity_gate.if_unlocked: Freeze a separate contract before fitting multistate capture-recapture/HMM estimates; do not reuse this benchmark contract as permission to explore.

allowed: Compare the order of magnitude and spatial scale of observed Ross Island location switching with the qualitative carrier possibilities left unidentified at Palmer.
Use the benchmark to argue that some latent carriers are biologically more or less plausible, while retaining Palmer non-identifiability.
prohibited: Transfer a Ross Island movement probability numerically into the Palmer model as if it were a Palmer parameter.
Claim that Ross Island fidelity proves Palmer breeding propensity is the carrier.
Treat Ross Island breeding-site categories as equivalent to Palmer colony_code spatial scale without an explicit crosswalk.

decision.movement_channel_descriptively_rare: switch_fraction upper 95% bootstrap bound < 0.05, only at the dataset's own site scale
